title: fix: RBAC v2 KMS region pinning - audit logging missing events on policy rollback
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Context: RBAC v2 introduced region pinning for KMS-backed keys and a stricter audit pipeline. During a roll forward/rollback scenario we observed missing audit events for policy rollback operations that change KMS region residency. This caused gaps in the audit trail for customer-sensitive key residency changes and failed an internal compliance check. Motivation: Ensure every RBAC v2 policy transition that impacts KMS region pinning emits complete, debuggable audit events (before/after state, actor, request id, and affected resources). This PR fixes the event path and hardens the policy resolver and audit handler to avoid swallowing events during error/rollback paths. Changes made: - Fix: propagate region residency changes through rbac policy transaction rollback path so audit events are enqueued on both success and rollback. - Fix: observability/audit handler now records before/after snapshots and includes KMS key id + region in structured payload. - Add: integration test covering policy apply -> induced failure -> rollback -> verify audit events persisted. - Add: defensive nil checks and explicit transaction finalizers in policy_resolver.go. - Docs: updated docs/keystore-region-residency.md to explain audit semantics for rollbacks and operator guidance. - Tests: unit tests for handler serialization and e2e integration test against the audit sink emulator. Checklist: - [x] Reproduced missing-audit gap locally and created regression test - [x] Implemented fix and added unit + integration tests - [x] Run full CI (lint/build/unit/integration) and fixed flakiness - [x] Security review by Priya Desai - [x] Updated docs and release notes Backwards compatibility: No public API changes. This is an internal behavior fix for audit logging paths. Release notes: "Fix: RBAC v2 - ensure audit events emit for policy rollbacks that modify KMS region pinning (security/compliance)."
